# SaltWatch 2.2.1

SaltWatch 2.2.1 refreshes the firmware toolchain and enables the additional
instruction-memory region supported by the current factory bootloader.

## Changes

- Updated validation and release builds from ESPHome 2026.8.1 to 2026.8.2.
- Enabled `esp32.framework.advanced.sram1_as_iram` for 40 KB of additional
  instruction RAM.
- Replaced the alphabetical local-device table with grouped, task-oriented
  Status, Calibration, Forecast and Refill, and Diagnostics sections.
- Retained the ESP-IDF 5.5.5 framework and all SaltWatch behavior and entity
  contracts from 2.2.0.

## Compatibility

This release assumes the ESP-IDF 5.5.5 factory bootloader shipped by the
SaltWatch browser installer. Devices should receive this release from a recent
USB factory installation before using later OTA-only updates.
